scope: Repository exploration and headless feasibility probes. No integrated DuckFly app, closed-loop fly-to-duck experiment, native renderer benchmark, or hardware test.

sources.name: microduck local
sources.note: Read-only orientation and reuse of its existing Python environment. Probe source/model are public upstream, not this fork.

probe_notes: 500 control ticks per trial; 50 Hz policy, 200 Hz physics; no actuator delay, nominal 7.4 V, voltage sag gain 0.1.

Projected gravity and initial command slots asserted. First preliminary probe accidentally used the PolicyInference raw-accelerometer default; its results were invalidated and are excluded from conclusions. Retained separately in the temporary exploration directory as microduck-probe-invalid-sensor-mode.json.
The higher-command probe is a follow-up to weak movement at the first command settings. It is diagnostic, not a preregistered efficacy comparison.
Timing excludes model loading, native neural simulation, rendering, IPC and OS pacing. No CPU-only fresh-install or .app packaging claim.
Probe scripts contain the temporary source root /tmp/duckfly-research.wzrXXM; restore clones and policy there or update ROOT before rerunning. Source commits and policy revision are pinned above.
